items.text: I can explain what an AMI is and why it is needed
I understand the difference between Quick Start AMIs, My AMIs, and Marketplace AMIs
I can explain the relationship between EBS Volume, EBS Snapshot, and AMI
I understand that AMIs are region-specific and not automatically global
I know what a 'golden AMI' is and why organizations use it
I can create a Custom AMI from a running EC2 instance using the AWS Console
I can verify an AMI is 'available' before using it to launch instances
I can launch a new EC2 instance from a Custom AMI (My AMIs tab)
I can copy an AMI to another AWS region using Actions → Copy AMI
I can properly delete an AMI by deregistering it AND deleting the EBS snapshot
I know that deregistering an AMI does NOT delete the underlying EBS snapshot
I know AMIs are region-specific — must be copied to be used elsewhere
I know an AMI status must be 'available' before it can launch instances
I can identify red flags in a job offer (no PF, no salary slip, vague compensation)
I understand that EBS snapshots capture only used data, not the full allocated volume size
